import pymysql

def drop_mysql_user_and_reassign_grants(host, admin_user, admin_password, target_user, target_host='%'):
    connection_to_server = pymysql.connect(host=host, user=admin_user, password=admin_password, autocommit=True)
    revoked_statement_count = 0
    try:
        with connection_to_server.cursor() as database_cursor:
            # Record the removal request in the admin schema before doing any work
            database_cursor.execute('INSERT INTO admin.user_removal_log (db_user, db_host, requested_by, requested_at) VALUES (%s, %s, %s, NOW())', (target_user, target_host, admin_user))
            database_cursor.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mysql.user WHERE User = %s AND Host = %s', (target_user, target_host))
            account_exists_count = database_cursor.fetchone()[0]
            if account_exists_count == 0:
                return {'dropped': False, 'reason': 'account not found'}
            database_cursor.execute('REVOKE ALL PRIVILEGES, GRANT OPTION FROM %s@%s', (target_user, target_host))
            revoked_statement_count += 1
            database_cursor.execute('DROP USER %s@%s', (target_user, target_host))
            database_cursor.execute('DELETE FROM admin.access_audit WHERE db_user = %s AND db_host = %s', (target_user, target_host))
            audit_rows_deleted = database_cursor.rowcount
    finally:
        connection_to_server.close()
    return {'dropped': True, 'user': target_user, 'host': target_host, 'revoke_statements': revoked_statement_count, 'audit_rows_deleted': audit_rows_deleted}
